jobs.description: The second half of the national parcel tile bake (root ADR-0133 §7, ADR-0253): take the served Gold run parcel_served_gold made ready and bake, gate and promote it with bake-lakehouse-tiles (scripts/ops/parcel-tile-bake.sh bake): GDAL and tippecanoe in their capped containers, the maxzoom id gate, the first-release equivalence gate against the active release (ADR-0133 §4, ADR-0135, ADR-0251), the create-only upload and the promotion. It first tries a patch (root ADR-0323, ADR-0111 base plus patches): only the tiles the changed parcels touch are baked and published by a manifest swap, and a new base is baked only when the patch policy's bounds say so (ADR-0323 §8). Started when the Gold half reports a ready run, and daily as the fallback; with none waiting, nothing to do. Nothing reads PostGIS.
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-13..18 every bake run peaked at 939-954M under the old 1G cap (MemoryHigh 921M) and swapped up to 947M: the cap was sized as if the unit held only the script (GDAL and tippecanoe run in their own capped containers, config/tile-bake-containers.contract.json), but the publisher's bake-lakehouse-tiles runs in this unit too. It held the feature index of 39,876,546 parcels, 40 bytes each (1.6 GB), and eight runs reached the 115-minute limit inside the index build. The index is now built in sorted runs of 4 Mi records (160 MiB) merged from disk (lakehouse_tile_patch.rs INDEX_SORT_RUN_RECORDS); what the publisher still holds for a full national bake is the sorted id hashes (ServedIds, 16 bytes x 39.9M = 640 MB) and one run (160 MiB): computed about 0.9G, so 2G is above 1.5x the 954M peak and twice the computed demand; the next run logs the first uncapped peak

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Off since 2026-11-24 (disabled_reason) before any run of it finished: every run since 2026-11-19 ended at a time bound in the join, so there is no completed run to measure. first_run stays as the estimate its next first run is held to when root ADR-0613 turns it back on.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the national bake's steps measured on 2026-10-13 under contention (runbook parcel-tile-bake.md §4: GDAL 60 minutes, tippecanoe 109 minutes over 39.9M parcels) and the run budget of root ADR-0493: no partition starts after 4,200 s, and the largest 시도 (경북, about 12% of the parcels) takes about 1,600 s at z17 (12% of 169 minutes, and the 44% more tippecanoe time the Incheon sample measured for the added zoom, root ADR-0492), so a run ends by 4,200 + 1,600 + 120 s for its stop; the run that joins, gates and uploads after the last partition is in the cache reads only cached archives

jobs.disabled_reason: Off since 2026-11-24 until root ADR-0613 (the publisher merges the partition archives itself) is live: the national join has never finished (tile-join exceeded its time bound on 2026-11-20, 11-21 and three times on 11-23, after 51 minutes on 11-19), so every start reads the handoff and joins for up to 6,300 s and fails. Measured by W82c over 44 h to 2026-11-24: the one spark slot was busy 33.8 h, mostly with these runs (four failed runs of about 2 h a day, at the pool's highest weight), nine served Gold rebuilds waited 15 to 17 h and the public auction Gold has not run since 2026-11-20. Nothing is lost while it is off: the 16 partition archives stay in the create-only cache and the tiles keep serving the active release. Re-enable in the PR that follows ADR-0613's release going live.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.
